description: Main content on /journey/plan spans the full max-w-screen-xl container, matching the header width exactly. No sidebar grid column consumes horizontal space by default.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan on a desktop viewport (≥1024px)
Inspect the width of the header inner container (max-w-screen-xl)
Verify the main content area (hero, stepper, day content) has the same computed width as the header
Verify no right-hand sidebar column is occupying space in the default state
Resize to 768px viewport and verify the content still spans the full container width
Resize to 1440px viewport and verify the content does not exceed max-w-screen-xl

feature: Layout — Day Stepper Navigation Replaces Tab Pills
description: The horizontal row of bordered tab pill buttons is replaced by a numbered stepper component — a horizontal line of 7 numbered steps with topic labels beneath, connected by a thin rule. No rounded-border pill shapes.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Verify no bordered pill tab buttons are present
Verify a horizontal stepper is visible with 7 steps numbered 1 through 7
Verify each step shows a small circle marker and a short topic label beneath it (e.g. 'Survive', 'Admin')
Verify a connecting line or track runs between the step markers
Verify the active day marker is visually distinct (e.g. filled circle, bold label)
Click step 3 on the stepper
Verify the day content panel updates to Day 3

feature: Layout — Stepper Active and Completed States
description: Active day marker uses the vibe accent color. Completed day markers show a checkmark or filled dot in minuri-teal. Future days are muted.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Verify the Day 1 step marker uses the vibe accent color (--vibe-accent) since it is the default active day
Complete all tasks for Day 1
Verify the Day 1 marker changes to a completed state (checkmark or teal fill)
Click Day 3 to make it active
Verify Day 3 marker uses the vibe accent color
Verify Day 1 retains its completed state styling
Verify Days 4–7 appear muted or de-emphasised

feature: Sidebar Drawer — Toggle Button in Header
description: A 'Week' button appears in the page header alongside 'Start over'. Clicking it opens a slide-in drawer from the right side. The button label changes to reflect open/closed state.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan on desktop
Verify a 'Week' button is visible in the header next to 'Start over'
Verify no sidebar panel is visible by default
Click the 'Week' button
Verify a drawer panel slides in from the right
Verify the button label or icon changes to indicate the drawer is open (e.g. shows 'Close' or an X icon)
Click the button again
Verify the drawer slides out and is no longer visible

description: The drawer contains a 'Your week at a glance' section listing all 7 days with theme, completion state, and a clickable row that switches the active day and closes the drawer.
steps: Open the week drawer via the header toggle
Verify the drawer is labelled 'Your week at a glance'
Verify all 7 days are listed with their theme names
Verify the currently active day is visually highlighted
Verify completed days show a checkmark or done indicator
Click a different day row in the drawer
Verify the main content switches to that day
Verify the drawer closes after the day selection

description: Below the week list, the drawer shows a 'Your vibe' section with the color swatch, hex code, vibe name, and traits text.
steps: Open the week drawer
Scroll to the bottom of the drawer
Verify a 'Your vibe' section is present
Verify it shows a color swatch square in the current vibe hex color
Verify the vibe name (e.g. 'Coral Drift') is displayed
Verify the hex value (e.g. '#F76C6C') is displayed in monospace
Verify the traits description text is displayed below the swatch row
Refresh the page and open the drawer
Verify the vibe shown matches the --vibe-accent CSS variable applied to the page

feature: Sidebar Drawer — Overlay Behaviour and Dismiss
description: The drawer overlays the main content (does not push it). Clicking the backdrop or pressing Escape closes it.
steps: Open the week drawer
Verify the main content is visible behind the drawer (drawer overlays, not pushes)
Verify a semi-transparent backdrop is rendered behind the drawer
Click on the backdrop (outside the drawer panel)
Verify the drawer closes
Open the drawer again
Press the Escape key
Verify the drawer closes

feature: Day Content — No Outer Card Border
description: The day content area renders directly on the page background with no rounded-2xl bordered card wrapper. Structure and hierarchy come from typography and spacing alone.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Inspect the day content area in devtools
Verify there is no element with both a border and border-radius wrapping the day header, guides, and tasks together
Verify the day header, guide list, and task list sit directly on the white page background
Verify visual separation between sections is achieved via spacing or a divider rule, not a card border
Switch between days and verify each day renders without a card wrapper

description: The user's moment text is displayed as a typographic pull-quote: large italic text with a vibe-accent left border bar. No background fill, no rounded box, no outer border.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Locate the user's moment text below the H1
Verify the text is rendered in italic style
Verify there is no background fill or rounded-border container around the quote
Verify a left-side accent bar is present in the vibe accent color (--vibe-accent)
Verify the bar is a thin vertical line (2–4px wide), not a full box border
Inspect devtools and confirm no bg-* fill class is applied to the quote wrapper

description: Guides are displayed as flat expandable rows showing only the guide title and reading time. No full GuideCard (thumbnail, summary, bookmark) visible by default.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Verify guides for the active day are rendered as compact rows, not full cards
Verify each row shows the guide title and reading time (e.g. '5 min')
Verify no guide thumbnail image is visible in the collapsed state
Verify no guide summary paragraph is visible in the collapsed state
Verify an expand indicator (e.g. chevron or arrow) is visible on each row
Verify the rows have no rounded border card styling

description: Clicking a guide row expands it inline to reveal the guide summary and a 'Read guide' link. Collapsing hides the expanded content.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Click the first guide row
Verify the row expands to show the guide summary paragraph
Verify a 'Read guide' or equivalent CTA link is visible
Verify the expand indicator rotates or changes to reflect the open state
Click the row again
Verify the expanded content collapses and is no longer visible
Verify the row returns to its default compact appearance

feature: Guide Accordion — Multiple Guides Independently Expandable
description: When a day has 2–3 guides, each row can be expanded and collapsed independently. Expanding one does not collapse another.
steps: Navigate to a day that has at least 2 guides
Expand the first guide row
Verify the first guide's summary is visible
Click the second guide row to expand it
Verify both the first and second guide summaries are simultaneously visible
Collapse the first guide row
Verify only the first guide collapses; the second remains expanded

feature: Guide Accordion — CTA Link Routes to Guide Page
description: The 'Read guide' link inside an expanded accordion row routes to the correct guide page with suburb and journey referral parameters.
steps: Complete onboarding with suburb 'Fitzroy' and navigate to /journey/plan
Expand any guide row
Click the 'Read guide' link
Verify the browser routes to /guides/[arc]/[slug]
Verify the URL contains ?suburb=Fitzroy
Verify the URL contains ?from=journey
Verify the guide page loads without errors

feature: Task List — Flat Style Without Outer Border Box
description: The task list renders as plain divide-y separated rows with no outer rounded border container and no background-fill header row. The 'Your tasks today' label is plain uppercase text above the list.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Locate the task list below the guide accordion
Verify there is no rounded-border card wrapping all the task rows together
Verify the 'Your tasks today' label is rendered as plain text above the list, not as a header row inside a bordered container
Verify task rows are separated by a divider line only (no card border)
Verify the task rows sit directly on the page background with no fill
Verify checking a task still updates the row styling (strikethrough, teal icon)

description: Previous and next day navigation uses plain text links with no pill border buttons. Labels show the adjacent day name, not just 'Previous day' / 'Next day'.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Locate the day navigation below the task list
Verify there are no rounded-pill bordered buttons for previous/next
Verify the navigation is rendered as plain text links (e.g. '← Day 1 · Survive' and 'Day 3 · Health →')
Verify the links include the adjacent day's theme or short label
Click the next link
Verify the day content switches to the next day
On Day 1 verify no 'previous' link is rendered
On the last day verify no 'next' link is rendered

feature: Layout — Section Divider Between Day Header and Guides
description: A full-width horizontal rule in the topic color separates the day header (icon + narrative) from the guide list below. No card border needed for visual grouping.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Observe the transition from the day narrative text to the guide list
Verify a horizontal divider or subtle rule is present between them
Verify the divider uses the topic color (e.g. orange for food-eating, sky for getting-around)
Switch to a different day
Verify the divider color updates to match the new day's topic color

feature: Mobile — Drawer Full-Screen on Small Viewports
description: On mobile viewports the week drawer takes up the full screen width rather than a partial panel.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan at a 375px viewport
Tap the 'Week' button in the header
Verify the drawer covers the full screen width
Verify week list and vibe section are both scrollable within the drawer
Tap outside or press the close button
Verify the drawer closes and full-width content is restored

description: On narrow viewports the day stepper overflows horizontally with scroll rather than wrapping or truncating.
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan at a 375px viewport
Verify the stepper is visible
Verify all 7 day steps are accessible via horizontal scroll
Verify no step labels are clipped or hidden
Scroll the stepper to Day 7
Click Day 7
Verify the content panel updates to Day 7
